race.comment: ZIGGY STARCRAFT (2) sets the benchmark after a narrow second at this track in BM55 grade, where he was well-supported favourite, began slowly and still finished strongly to be beaten just over half a length. His Townsville BM55 win the start prior adds substance, and the weight relief from 60kg is a genuine plus. THUNDER BLAZE (3) is the form runner after consecutive wins, most recently a dominant BM55 success at this track over Rum Rumble, and his one-from-one record at the distance keeps him right in the discussion despite the quick five-day return. CORPULENT (1) is better placed dropping out of Class 4 company after being beaten just over three lengths here first-up, with the awkward start and early wide run giving him some excuse. YOUMEANDDUPRE (4) comes through a BM60 win at this track and has a useful record around this distance, though his narrow margin and broader profile make him more of a value danger than a clear-cut winning force.
